results.description:
Start your own Dog Town by breeding and collecting dogs. Experience dogs training where your puppies can learn lots of new tricks. You can use your voice to give commands to your dogs like in real life! You will collect dogs, train them, get medals, level them up & send to quests & funny adventures for exciting in-game rewards! Take care of your puppy, wash, groom & feed. In Dog Town you can customize the rooms where your dogs live! Design your own interiors with hundreds of exclusive decorations.
Are you ready to build your virtual Dog Town? Let’s get started!

In Dog Town you can:
• Train your dogs and teach them lots of tricks with new training feature!
• Breed and Collect new dogs! 
• Enjoy gorgeous 3D environment! 
• Play with realistic Dogs with lifelike behavior!
• Take care of your dogs: brush, wash, train, pet & feed!
• Level up your dogs and send them to quests!
• Decorate your rooms with hundreds of decorations! 
• Collect more than 100 dogs and more coming with each update!

If you always wanted to adopt pets, play with puppies and dogs & were interested in animal shelter, pet & dog rescue then this is one of the best virtual games for you. Each animal has a unique character and behavior, so you will always recognize your "Sleepy" from the "Jumpy"! Also you will see their unique behavior while training your puppy. We've put a tremendous amount of effort to ensure that you would feel attached to your dogs just like you would to the real ones.

In Dog Town you can collect dog breeds like: Basset hound, Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Springer Spaniel, Boston Terrier, Labrador Retriever, Australian Shepherd, German Shepherd, Yorkshire Terrier, Bull Terrier, Great Dane, Schnauzer, Cocker Spaniel, French Bulldog, Pomeranian, Doberman, Siberian Husky, Miniature Pinscher, Beagle, Chihuahua, Corgi, Dachshund and many other dog breeds. There is a large emphasis on Dog Collection and management for casual and midcore players. 

Download now and start having fun!

Dominate the Zooba Arena and Become the Ultimate Shooting Star!

Download Zooba now and become the ultimate star in this epic battle royale game!

The original Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp game was released in 2017. This new one-time purchase app is packed with items and events that were released over the course of seven years. It keeps the general game play of Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp without additional in-game purchases.

As a campsite manager, it's up to you to build a fun campsite. While working as the manager, you can also fish, catch bugs, chat with animals, and collect your favorite furniture.
You can also change into your favorite outfit, make lots of detours, and enjoy your relaxing camp life!

◆ Decorate your campsite with over 10,000 items
From tents and swings to lazy rivers and merry-go-rounds, there are tons of items you can use to decorate your campsite with to your taste.

◆ Meet the animals
A lot of animals with quirky personalities will make an appearance. The animals are very curious about your campsite. The animal pal you choose as a camp caretaker will help you with your job. Walk around the forest together and get inspiration on how to build a lovely campsite.

◆ Tons of seasonal events
There will be lots of events such as Garden Events and Fishing Tourneys every month. Don't forget Halloween, Toy Day, Bunny Day, and the Summer Festival. Jump into these events to collect seasonal items.

==========New Game Play Added to the Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete Game==========

◆ Camper Cards
You can create a Camper Card that introduces you. Pick a color and pose and it's done. You can also scan other players' Camper Cards and enjoy trading and collecting. 

◆ Gatherings at the Whistle Pass
You can visit a new place that didn't exist in Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp. Other players whose Camper Cards you registered will come visit. Enjoy music, with a nightly live guitar performance by K.K. Slider.

◆ Complete Ticket
When you participate in events, you can earn Complete Tickets. Exchange them for limited-edition items that you missed out on or fortune cookies of your choice.

◆ Enjoy Custom Designs
You can scan Custom Designs created in the Animal Crossing: New Horizons game for the Nintendo Switch system, then wear or otherwise use them in the app.

※Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete only supports downloading Custom Designs. You cannot create new Custom Designs in the app.

Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete is packed with fun. Decorate your dream campsite!

※Although constant online connection is not required, temporary data communication may be required for the following processes, which may result in data communication usage.
　・ Communicating with your Nintendo Account
　・ Updating the time
　・ Downloading data such as software updates

※Some events may not function properly if you change the time on your device.

※Save data will be saved onto your device.

※Please note that if you delete the app, save data will also be deleted.

※Operation is not guaranteed for all devices that meet the operating conditions. It may not work properly depending on the device's performance and specifications, device-specific application usage conditions, etc.

※Certain items from Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp will not be available in Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete.

※Custom Designs can be applied to clothing, umbrellas, uchiwa fans, handheld flags, face-cutout standees, and path/flooring.

May include advertising.

results.description:
The Nintendo Switch App smartphone app enhances your online gameplay experience on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Nintendo Switch systems. With this app, you can use friend features and game-specific services for compatible games even when you're not playing! You can also view and share screenshots and videos uploaded from your system.

◆ Check friends' online status

You can check whether your friends are online and see what games they're playing. You can also choose to receive a notification in the app when a friend comes online.

◆ Use your smartphone to add friends

You can add friends via their friend code or a QR code even when you're not using your system.

◆ View your screenshots and videos

You can upload screenshots and videos saved in your Nintendo Switch 2 system's Album to the app, then view, save, and share them.

◆ Access game-specific services

You can use these services to view helpful information related to the supported software! You will also have access to a variety of features that will help take your online gameplay experience to the next level.

Currently, game-specific services are available for these games:

　・ The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and The Legend of Zelda™: Tears of the Kingdom – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
　　　・ Get voice guidance to help you reach locations you haven't visited yet
　　　・ Share schematics and items via QR codes
　　　...And more!

　・ Splatoon™ 3
　　　・ View the online status of friends playing the game
　　　・ View your battle and Salmon Run stats
　　　・ View upcoming stage schedules
　　　...And more!

　・ Animal Crossing™: New Horizons
　　　・ Send custom designs created in Animal Crossing games on the Nintendo 3DS™ system to the Animal Crossing: New Horizons game
　　　・ Use your smartphone to send messages that appear in-game
　　　・ Check the online status of users set as Best Friends
　　　...And more!

　・ Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate
　　　・ View posted images and videos
　　　・ Queue downloads of user-created stages to play them in your game
　　　・ Get notifications about upcoming events
　　　...And more!

　・ Splatoon™ 2
　　　・ Check leaderboards and map schedules
　　　・ View your battle and Salmon Run stats
　　　...And more!

Important Information:
● Nintendo Account age 13+ required to access some online features, including voice chat.
● Active Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) required to use certain features.
● Nintendo Switch 2 / Nintendo Switch system and compatible software required to use app features.
● Compatible smartphone required.
● Persistent internet connection required.
● Data charges may apply.
● May include advertising.

For more information about GameChat, visit support.nintendo.com

◆ Nintendo Switch Online is not available in all countries. Terms apply. Visit nintendo.com/purchase-terms for more information.
